verdictScope: Only the actual visible pixels of the eight assigned native-scale crops. No observed display defect; no semantic or whole-card approval.

method.basis: Actual pixels inspected through functions.view_image, detail original, once per assigned crop.

recipes.visibleContent: Final choices item: complete C, D, E and F labels and option text, followed by blank document-end space.

findings.text: Chinese prose and Latin option labels are readable. Wrapped lines remain inside the visible width with clear separation between options; no overlap or right-edge glyph clipping is visible.

findings.location: F final line and lower blank area
findings.text: F ends with a short wrapped final line. Its punctuation is visible and the subsequent bottom space contains no cut-off continuation.
The stem, A/B options and preceding choices are not visible in this batch. Their display is unobserved, not assumed to pass.

recipes.visibleContent: Answer heading; complete questions/answers 1-3; question 4 and beginning of its answer.

findings.text: Title, blue outer numbers, source question numbers and body prose are legible. The number gutter, paragraph column and horizontal separators do not overlap. Line and block spacing support reading.

findings.location: Question 4 stem and first answer paragraph
findings.text: The long question fits the desktop text column. The visible answer lines have no horizontal clipping or collisions.
Question 4's next paragraph continues below the prescribed rectangle. This is a crop boundary, not a page defect; this crop alone does not show its complete answer.

recipes.visibleContent: Question 4 answer continuation; complete questions/answers 5 and 6, including the three-item applications list and final math paragraph.

findings.text: The first visible lines belong to the paragraph that started in the preceding assigned desktop crop. The paragraph's start is not visible here; the fixed crop split is not a page-layout defect.

Pi, d, the Chinese-subscript optical-path term, 1/n fractions and lambda = v/f are distinguishable and fit the prose column. Fractions retain space above and below their bars; no formula/prose collision is visible.

List numbering and three wrapped application items are readable. The index inequality, 2h fraction, equation label (7.8), and 5.5 times 10 to the minus fifth power fit without horizontal clipping or overlap. The final sentence and punctuation are visible.
The final assigned desktop strip is uniformly blank to visual inspection. No clipped text, formula, label or overlapping element appears in this strip.
This is margin-only evidence. Readability and math fit cannot be judged from a crop containing no text or math.

recipes.visibleContent: Answer heading; complete questions/answers 1 and 2; question 3 stem reaches the lower recipe edge.

findings.text: The title fits the mobile width. Blue outer numbers remain separate from the question/body column. Chinese lines wrap legibly inside the right edge, with clear line spacing and section separators; no horizontal clipping or overlap is visible.

findings.location: Question 3 stem at bottom, document y = 844
findings.text: The stem reaches the prescribed crop boundary. Its continuation and answer are not fully observed in this crop; the edge split is not a page defect.

recipes.visibleContent: Question 3 answer; complete question 4 stem; its first answer paragraph and most of its second paragraph.

findings.text: Small remnants of the question 3 stem occur at the recipe boundary. Its full stem is not independently visible here; this is the prescribed split.

findings.location: Question 3 body, question 4 stem and answer
findings.text: Body text, the two-line question 4 stem, and paragraphs remain legible and separated. Long Chinese lines do not collide with the number gutter or run beyond the visible page.
Pi, d, and the 2n-with-Chinese-subscript times d term are visible and fit their lines without formula or baseline overlap.
Question 4's second paragraph continues into the next assigned crop. The lower-edge split does not establish page clipping.

recipes.visibleContent: Question 4 answer tail; complete question/answer 5; question 6 stem, introduction, first list item and beginning of second list item.

findings.text: The first visible line resumes question 4 within its paragraph. The preceding text is not visible in this crop; the split is not a page defect.

The 1/n fractions in the wrapped stem/body and lambda = v/f remain readable and inside the mobile column. Fraction bars, denominators and surrounding punctuation do not collide with neighboring lines.

findings.location: Question 6 stem, introduction and first list item
findings.text: The blue item number, question text, introduction and list numbering are distinct. The first application item wraps cleanly and ends visibly.

findings.location: Second list item at bottom, document y = 2532
findings.text: The second item continues beyond this assigned rectangle. No complete question 6 answer is inferred from this crop alone.

recipes.visibleContent: Question 6 second-list-item continuation, complete third list item and final paragraph, followed by blank bottom margin.

findings.text: The second list item starts in the preceding assigned crop. Its continuation at this top boundary is expected; this is not missing page content.
Chinese wrapping and the third item's label are readable and do not overlap. Paragraph separation clearly distinguishes the list from the final explanatory paragraph.

The refractive-index inequality wraps across lines with its next term visible. Chinese subscripts, pi, the 2h fraction and the (7.8) label remain distinguishable. The equation label wraps to the next line without collision; no visible formula is truncated.

findings.location: Scientific notation, last sentence and bottom margin
findings.text: 5.5 times 10 to the minus fifth power is legible, including its raised exponent. The final sentence ends visibly above clear bottom space, with no cut-off continuation.

coverage.excludedScrollbar: The assigned PNG widths are 15 pixels narrower than the requested viewports, as recorded in the bound capture metadata. The missing scrollbar strip is not inferred to contain lesson content.

limitations: Display readability and fit only. No answer correctness, SCI, source fidelity, translation or figure-semantic review.
Recipe edges are sampling boundaries, not actual page ends, except the final strips reaching the mechanically verified source height.
No interaction behavior, live browser state or horizontal scrolling was exercised.
The bounded batch PASS does not release the capture plan's visual hold or authorize canonical promotion.
